connector.name: MCP Neo4j Cypher
connector.registryDescription: A simple Neo4j MCP server that allows you to run Cypher queries against a Neo4j database.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-neo4j-cypher. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the neo4j-contrib account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NEO4J_RESPONSE_TOKEN_LIMIT
env.description: Maximum tokens for read query responses

env.name: NEO4J_READ_TIMEOUT
env.description: Timeout in seconds for read queries
